card.title: IPhone 11 No Cellular Service, No IMEI Present

source.title: IPhone 11 No Cellular Service, No IMEI Present

claims.statement: iPhone 11 baseband faults: sandwich separation (ripped pads; test in iSocket), a cracked transceiver U_XCVR (marked 5765), or a shorted PA_HB_K amplifier.
A bottom board swap rules out the cellular circuit (move BB CPU, BB EEPROM, Wi-Fi; NFC optional); BB CPU reball alone has lower success.

procedure: Split and inspect; test in iSocket.
Bottom board swap or BB CPU reball.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
